name: logseq-claude
description: Ask Claude AI directly from any Logseq block using a slash command. Responses are inserted as nested blocks with full markdown support.
author: Mike Travers

settingsSchema.title: Anthropic API Key
settingsSchema.description: Your Anthropic API key (get one at console.anthropic.com)

settingsSchema.default: Be direct and concise. Do not use filler phrases like 'that is a great question', 'that is genuinely interesting', 'certainly', or 'of course'. Get straight to the point.
settingsSchema.title: System Prompt
settingsSchema.description: System prompt sent with every request. Use this to set Claude's tone and style.

settingsSchema.title: Response Tag
settingsSchema.description: If set, this tag is appended to the first inserted response block (e.g. '#ai-response'). Leave blank to disable.

settingsSchema.title: Google Voice Export Path
settingsSchema.description: Local path to an unzipped Google Takeout export root (the folder containing Voice/), used by /Import Google Voice. Local file reading is not implemented yet — see spec/voice.md.

settingsSchema.title: Google Voice: Include Audio Link
settingsSchema.description: When importing Google Voice recordings, also insert a link to the local .mp3 alongside the transcript.
